title: The Plant That Counted the Seasons
short_teaser: Botanists learned that many plants do not simply respond to warmth.
story: Botanists learned that many plants do not simply respond to warmth. They also measure changing lengths of daylight, allowing them to flower, rest, or prepare for winter at the right time. A living system can use more than one signal before deciding it is time to act. Discovery grows when we notice what does not fit, stay with the question, and resist the urge to explain it away too quickly. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: A living system can use more than one signal before deciding it is time to act. Discovery grows when we notice what does not fit, stay with the question, and resist the urge to explain it away too quickly.
spark_application: Write down one unexpected result or unanswered question from your own work. List three explanations before choosing one. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
